points.text: Puerto Rico’s Jennifer Barreto was crowned Miss Universe 2026, becoming the first mother to win the title.
The Pittsburgh Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers for Mason Rudolph and released Rodgers before their game against Denver.
Nidal Hasan asked a federal court to delay his scheduled execution while he prepares a petition challenging his sentence.
The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million satellites for orbital data centers, despite opposition from Amazon and other groups.
The Trump administration proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China, the European Union, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and India.
